# Draft:Blockware Mining

Blockware Mining is an American cryptocurrency mining company based in Kentucky. It operates bitcoin mining facilities and infrastructure projects in the United States, particularly in western and eastern Kentucky.
Background
Blockware Mining emerged as part of a broader expansion of cryptocurrency mining in Kentucky in the early 2020s, supported by state-level tax incentives aimed at attracting energy-intensive industries. The company was approved for state tax incentives tied to a proposed facility in Paducah, Kentucky. Newspapers in Illinois, Indiana, and Kentucky have reported on the company’s role in the growth of cryptocurrency mining operations in the Ohio Valley and surrounding areas.
Industry publications have reported that the company raised approximately $25 million in 2021 to expand its bitcoin mining operations and increase its computational capacity. The company has also developed large-scale mining data centers in Kentucky, including facilities with capacity in the tens of megawatts.
Public radio reporting has placed Blockware among several firms contributing to the rise of cryptocurrency mining in the Ohio Valley, a development linked to regional economic transition and access to low-cost electricity.
